en: The outside ski carries more than the inside: in the muscle table the outside quads and adductors are higher.
tw: 外腳受力比內腳多：看肌肉表，外腳股四頭肌和內收肌會比較高。

en: The outside ski carries the most; its inside edge bites and carries you round. Upper body faces downhill, hands in front.
tw: 外腳受力最多，外腳的內刃咬雪帶著轉。上半身面向下坡，手放在前面。

en: The outside ski loads quickly with a little tail skid for speed control; keep the rhythm quick, don't linger mid-turn.
tw: 外腳快速加壓，板尾稍微搓雪控速；節奏要快，不要停在彎中。

en: The outside leg is almost straight, holding the GRF; the inside leg shortens so the body can keep moving into the turn.
tw: 外腳接近伸直撐住地面反作用力，內腳收短，讓身體可以繼續入彎。

en: The outside ski keeps pushing the tail out (a wider wedge slows you down), then get ready to switch sides.
tw: 外腳繼續推住板尾（犁式開大一點就會減速），之後準備換邊。

en: The outside ski loads progressively and angulation appears; shoulders roughly parallel to the slope.
tw: 外腳逐漸加壓，反弓開始出現；肩膀大致與坡面平行。

en: The thighs rotate into the turn to steer the skis, with a little tail skid; the upper body keeps facing downhill (counter).
tw: 大腿往彎內旋轉帶板子轉，板尾稍微搓雪；上半身保持面向下坡（反向扭轉）。

en: The thighs rotate in the hip sockets to steer the skis (upper/lower body separation); the obliques hold the upper body's direction isometrically.
tw: 大腿在骨盆裡旋轉帶板子轉（上下半身分離），腹斜肌等長收縮撐住上半身方向。

en: The thighs rotate in the hip sockets; the upper body stays still.
tw: 大腿在骨盆裡轉，上半身不動。

en: Greater. The difference comes from knee and hip angulation.
tw: 大於。差距來自膝蓋和髖部的反弓。
屈曲吸收，像避震器一樣。

en: The left foot (the outside of the turn). Pressing the outside ski makes it turn.
tw: 左腳（彎外那隻）。外腳加壓，板子就會轉。

en: Slowly move your weight onto the ski on the outside of the turn, pressing the knee and foot slightly toward the inside. Don't turn the upper body with it.
tw: 慢慢把重量移到彎外那隻腳，膝蓋和腳掌微微往彎內方向壓。上半身不要跟著轉。

en: Hand all your weight to the outside ski; you're only really standing on it if you can stay balanced.
tw: 所有重量交給外腳，站得穩才算真的站在外腳上。

en: Drag to rotate 360°, pinch to zoom · one cycle = two turns · tap a row in the muscle table to isolate that group
tw: 拖曳 360° 旋轉、雙指縮放・一個循環 = 兩個彎・點肌肉表任一列可單獨查看該組肌肉

en: Drag to rotate · pinch to zoom
Pick a narrow run and imagine walls on both sides; count 'plant, turn, plant, turn' in your head.
tw: 選一條窄雪道，假設兩邊有牆；心裡數「點、轉、點、轉」。

en: With the inside ski lifted, where on the outside foot should your weight be?
tw: 提起內腳之後，重心應該在外腳的哪裡？

en: Which muscles lift the inside ski?
Before the edge change, touch the new inside pole lightly to draw the CoM forward and downhill.
tw: 換刃前輕點新內側的雪杖，帶重心往前往下坡。

en: At the edge change, should the body extend up or press down?
tw: 換刃時，身體應該往上伸還是往下壓？

en: After the edge change, steer the skis by rotating the thighs inward — don't drag them round with the upper body.
tw: 換刃後用大腿內旋帶板子轉，不是用上半身拖。

en: At the edge change the CoM crosses over the skis, on a much shorter path than the ski tracks.
tw: 換刃時重心從雙板上方越過，路線比板痕短很多。

en: Both skis stay on the snow through the edge change; then hand all the weight straight to the new outside ski.
tw: 換刃時兩隻腳都在雪上，換完立刻把重量全部交給新外腳。

en: Both skis touch down at the edge change, then hand all the weight to the new outside ski.
tw: 換刃時兩隻腳都落地，再把重量全部交給新外腳。

en: Both skis down at the edge change
Absorb when you hit the bump, extend into the trough, keep the upper body smooth.
tw: 撞上就收腳，進凹槽就伸腳，上半身保持平穩。

en: When you hit the face of a mogul, should your legs straighten or flex?
tw: 撞上蘑菇面時，腳應該伸直還是屈曲？

en: When you hit the face of a mogul, flex knees and hips to absorb; extend into the trough to keep the skis on the snow. The yellow CoM line should be much smoother than the snow surface.
tw: 撞上蘑菇面就屈膝屈髖吸收，進凹槽就伸腳讓雪板貼雪。黃色重心線應該比雪面平順很多。

en: Flatten the edges, rotate the thighs, keep the upper body still, slide straight down the fall line.
tw: 立刃放平，大腿轉，上半身不動，沿滾落線直線下滑。

en: Flatten the edges and the tips turn naturally toward the fall line — like half a turn.
tw: 立刃放平，板頭自然轉向滾落線，像半個彎。

en: Flatten both skis and rotate the thighs in the hip sockets so the skis pass through the fall line to the other side; the upper body doesn't move at all.
tw: 雙板放平，大腿在骨盆裡旋轉，讓雙板經過滾落線轉到另一邊；上半身完全不動。

en: The whole drill slides straight down the fall line — you shouldn't drift left or right.
tw: 整個練習是沿著滾落線直線下滑，不應該往左右偏。

en: In a traverse, which ski carries more weight?
tw: 斜滑降時，哪隻腳承受比較多重量？

en: The new outside ski edges progressively ankle → knee → hip, the adductors bring the knee into the turn; the tibialis anterior keeps the boot tongue engaged. Tip into the turn before GRF builds.
tw: 新外腳由腳踝→膝蓋→髖部逐級入刃，內收肌把膝蓋帶入彎；脛前肌拉住鞋舌保持前壓。在地面反作用力變大之前就傾倒入彎。

en: Tip in early, hold with the outside ski, keep the upper body level and let the skis do the turning.
tw: 早點傾倒入彎，外腳撐住，上半身保持水平，讓板子自己轉。

en: Ski R = sidecut radius (the R number printed on the ski). When carving, turn radius ≈ R × cos(edge angle) and lean angle comes from tan θ = v² / (g·r), so speed, R and edge are all linked. This is an idealised formula: real skis bend deeper and the snow packs down, so you can actually carve a bit faster. Recommended ranges are rules of thumb, not hard limits.
tw: 板子 R = 側切半徑（板身上寫的 R 數字）。刻滑時轉彎半徑 ≈ R × cos(立刃角度)，傾倒角由 tan θ = v² / (g·r) 算出，所以速度、R、立刃三者互相牽動。這是理想化公式，實際上板子會彎得更深、雪會被壓實，所以實際可以刻滑得快一點。建議範圍是一般經驗值，不是硬性規定。

en: Skis turn, pelvis and upper body don't: the adductors and glute med rotate the thighs.
tw: 板子轉、骨盆和上半身不轉：內收肌、臀中肌負責大腿旋轉。

en: No pressure on the tips: slow initiation and the tips don't bite; at the end of the turn the tails push you out and you speed up. The quads have to hold eccentrically for a long time so the thighs burn fast. In moguls you'll get bucked off.
tw: 板頭沒有壓力，入彎慢、板頭咬不住雪；彎尾會被板尾推出去，越滑越快。股四頭肌要長時間離心收縮撐住，大腿很快就痠。在蘑菇裡會被彈飛。

en: Too much pressure on the tips and none on the tails: the tails skid out and you can't carve a clean arc; you can't release at the end of the turn and the tips can trip you at the edge change.
tw: 板頭壓力太大、板尾沒有壓力，板尾會打滑（搓雪甩出），刻不出乾淨的弧線；出彎放不掉，換刃時容易被板頭絆住。

en: Tips close, tails apart, both skis on their inside edges (blue edge on both).
tw: 板頭靠近、板尾打開，兩支板都用內刃（兩邊都有藍色刃）。

en: In the side slip, use the uphill edges lightly to control speed — don't dig in too much.
tw: 橫滑時用上坡側的刃輕輕控速，不要吃得太深。

en: While crossing the run, try lifting the uphill ski — if you stay balanced you're doing it right; in the garland feel the difference between 'release' and 'bite'.
tw: 橫越雪道時試著提起上坡腳，站得穩才對；做 garland 時感受「放」和「咬」的差別。

en: Say 'up, press' in your head for each turn; look at a point far ahead and make sure your shoulders don't turn with the skis.
tw: 每個彎心裡喊「起、壓」的節奏；看著遠方一點，注意肩膀不要跟著板子轉。

en: Just before each edge change, drawing the body forward into the next turn.
tw: 每次換刃之前，帶身體往前進入下一個彎。

en: Plant the pole before every edge change to draw the CoM forward and downhill.
tw: 每次換刃前點杖，帶重心往前往下坡。

en: Ideal: press the forefoot (around the ball of the big toe) entering the turn with shins against the boot tongues; move back to mid-foot at the apex; drift slightly back at the exit, but never onto the heels. Outside foot presses on its inside (big-toe side), inside foot lightly on its outside (little-toe side).
tw: 理想做法：入彎壓前腳掌（拇趾球附近），脛骨貼住鞋舌；Apex 時移回腳掌中間；出彎慢慢往後一點，但不要坐到腳跟。外腳壓內側（拇趾側），內腳輕輕用外側（小趾側）。

en: Control speed with the skid angle, flex to absorb, get ready for the next pole plant.
tw: 用搓雪角度控速，屈曲吸收，準備下一次點杖。

en: set by speed and achievable lean
tw: 由速度和做得到的傾倒決定

en: The contraction type is computed from the model's joint angle changes: muscle lengthening while active = eccentric, shortening = concentric, roughly unchanged = isometric.
tw: 發力類型是由模型關節角度的變化算出來的：肌肉變長又在出力 = 離心收縮，變短 = 向心收縮，幾乎沒變 = 等長收縮。

en: In short turns, which way should the upper body face?
tw: 小迴轉時上半身應該面向哪裡？

en: Isometric: length unchanged, holding a position
tw: 等長收縮 Isometric：長度不變，靜止撐住姿勢

en: Thick line = CoM path (colour = phase, dashed = airborne), grey line = ski track, short grey lines = ski direction, yellow dot = current position, green 'S' → red 'E'. Tap anywhere on the map to jump to that moment.
tw: 粗線 = 重心路線（顏色 = 階段，虛線 = 離地），灰線 = 板痕，短灰線 = 板子方向，黃點 = 目前位置，綠色「起」→ 紅色「完」。點地圖任一處可以跳到那個時刻。

en: The purple force line runs from the outside foot through the CoM = balanced; if it misses the CoM you fall into the turn or get thrown out of it.
tw: 紫色力線從外腳穿過重心 = 平衡；穿不過重心就會倒進彎內或被甩出彎外。

en: Muscle / role (tap a row to isolate)
tw: 肌肉／作用（點一列可單獨查看）

en: Mid-foot. Sitting back burns your thighs quickly and you lose control of the skis.
tw: 腳掌中間。後坐會讓大腿很快痠，又控制不了板子。

en: Mid-foot, slightly forward — not on the heel.
tw: 腳掌中間偏前，不是腳跟。

en: Foot map: outside foot 100%, CoP at mid-foot slightly forward.
tw: 腳掌圖：外腳 100%，CoP 在腳掌中間偏前。

en: Legs at their shortest, pivot the edge change on top of the bump (tips and tails off the snow, easiest to turn); plant the pole on the top or back of the bump, upper body facing downhill.
tw: 腳收到最短，在蘑菇頂轉向換刃（板頭板尾離雪，最好轉）；點杖在蘑菇頂或蘑菇背，上半身保持面向下坡。

en: Legs at their longest, skis skid in the trough to control speed; the upper body glides down a straight line and doesn't bob with the legs.
tw: 腳伸到最長，雪板在凹槽用搓雪控速；上半身像沿著一條直線滑下來，不跟著腳上下動。

en: The hamstrings bend the knee to lift it, not the waist.
tw: 膕旁肌屈膝提起，不是用腰。

en: Knees and hips toward the hill, upper body facing down the hill = angulation; both skis on their uphill edges.
tw: 膝蓋和髖部朝上坡，上半身朝下坡 = 反弓，雙板用上坡側的刃。

en: Should knees and hips push toward the hill or down the hill?
tw: 膝蓋和髖部應該推向上坡還是下坡？

en: The old outside leg relaxes and flexes (cross-under), both skis roll flat together and onto the new edges; the CoM crosses over the feet from the old turn's inside. Abs and tibialis anterior bring the body forward — don't sit back.
tw: 舊外腳放鬆屈曲（cross-under），雙板同時放平再換到新的刃；重心從舊彎內側越過雙腳上方。腹直肌和脛前肌把身體帶向前，不要後坐。

en: Press the tips down the back of the bump (tibialis anterior); sit back and the next mogul will buck you off.
tw: 下蘑菇背時要壓板頭（脛前肌）；一後坐，下一個蘑菇就會把你彈飛。

en: Down the back of the bump: extend
Top of the bump: turn + pole plant
Touch the new inside pole lightly, extend the body forward and downhill to unweight, change both edges together and keep the skis parallel.
tw: 輕點新內側雪杖，身體往前往下坡伸展、減輕壓力，雙板一起換刃，保持平行。

en: Before turning, should you increase the edge angle or flatten it?
tw: 轉之前立刃應該加大還是放平？

en: Flatten both skis first (edge → 0°) so they turn smoothly.
tw: 轉之前先把雙板放平（立刃 → 0°），才轉得順。

en: Turning right, which foot should carry more force?
tw: 轉右彎時，哪隻腳要多出點力？

en: Steering comes from the thighs rotating in the hip sockets, not from twisting at the waist.
tw: 轉向是大腿在骨盆裡旋轉，不是扭腰。

en: When pivoting, which part of the body should turn?
tw: 轉向時，身體哪個部位應該轉？

en: Gradually reduce the edge angle, pressure moves from the front to the middle/back, the outside leg starts to flex (eccentric) to absorb, ready for the next transition.
tw: 逐步減少立刃角度，壓力由前移到中後段，外腳開始屈曲（離心收縮）吸收，準備下一個換刃。

en: Back seat: no pressure on the tips, thighs tire quickly.
tw: 重心偏後：板頭沒有壓力，大腿很快就累。

en: Too far forward: tails skid and you can't release at the exit.
tw: 重心太前：板尾打滑，出彎放不掉。

en: Should your weight be on the heels or the middle of the feet?
tw: 重心應該在腳跟還是腳掌中間？

en: Re-engage the uphill edges and turn back uphill; this is what the bottom half of a turn feels like.
tw: 重新吃上坡側的刃，轉回上坡；這一下就是轉彎下半段的感覺。

en: Add uphill edge again: the skis bite and turn back uphill, slowing you down.
tw: 重新加上坡側的立刃，雙板咬雪轉回上坡，速度慢下來。

en: Long outside leg, short inside leg
Skis across the hill, uphill edges biting lightly to control speed; upper body facing downhill, knees slightly bent.
tw: 雙板打橫，上坡側的刃輕輕咬雪控速；上半身面向下坡，膝蓋微彎。

en: Flatten the skis a little and the tips turn toward the fall line — like the start of half a turn.
tw: 雙板稍微放平，板頭轉向滾落線下滑，像半個彎的開頭。

en: Both skis cross the slope on their uphill edges, upper body facing downhill (angulation); uphill ski slightly ahead, downhill ski carrying the weight.
tw: 雙板用上坡側的刃橫越斜坡，上半身面向下坡（反弓）；上坡腳稍微在前，下坡腳承重。

en: The skis turn from one side to the other while the upper body keeps facing downhill.
tw: 雙板從一邊轉到另一邊，上半身一直面向下坡。

en: Extend the legs downward to keep the skis on the snow (concentric); press the tips into the trough — don't sit back.
tw: 雙腳往下伸展，讓雪板保持貼雪（向心收縮）；板頭壓進凹槽，不要後坐。

en: Flex knees and hips to absorb the impact (quads and glutes eccentric), brace the abs and don't let the mogul throw your upper body up.
tw: 雙腳屈膝屈髖吸收衝擊（股四頭肌、臀大肌離心收縮），腹肌收緊，不要讓蘑菇把上半身彈起。

en: Even weight: the outside ski doesn't grip, easily turning into an A-frame.
tw: 雙腳平均：外腳咬不牢，容易變成 A 字腿。

en: Eccentric: the muscle lengthens while still resisting (e.g. bending the knees to absorb load). This is the main source of 'burning' thighs in skiing
tw: 離心收縮 Eccentric：肌肉被拉長但仍然出力抵抗（例如屈膝吸收壓力）。滑雪大腿「痠」主要就是這種

en: Should your head move up and down with the moguls?
tw: 頭的高度應該跟著蘑菇上下嗎？

en: Bird's-eye view: the whole movement from start to end
tw: 鳥瞰圖：整個動作從開始到結束

en: The yellow CoM line runs almost straight down the hill while the feet swing side to side underneath.
tw: 黃色重心線幾乎是直線下山，雙腳在下面左右擺。

en: The yellow CoM trace is shorter than the ski tracks and takes the inside line — the body enters the turn first.
tw: 黃色重心軌跡比板痕短、走內線，表示身體先入彎。

en: When do you plant the pole?
Plant the pole while flexing to release; the skis flip to the new edges under the body; the upper body keeps facing downhill and doesn't follow the skis.
tw: 點杖的同時屈曲放刃，雙板在身體下方翻到新的刃；上半身一直面向下坡，不跟著板子轉。

en: Why is the inside leg working too?
